deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a library request or loan slip, or a draft of one, written by Riemann in 1855.

1. Line 1, in ink, names the work requested: "Mémoires présentés à l'Académie des sciences à Paris. T. 10. 11", that is, volumes 10 and 11.
2. The pencil lines below repeat and complete the bibliographic description: "de l'Inst[itut] de France / par divers savants / Sc[iences] math[ématiques] et phys[iques] / 1848. 1851". This is the series usually cited as 'Mémoires présentés par divers savants à l'Académie des sciences de l'Institut de France (Savants étrangers)'. The two years are the publication years of tomes 10 (1848) and 11 (1851).
3. A dated line, "Göttingen, den 10. Aug. 1855.", is struck through.
4. On the right, Riemann practises or repeats his signature and address several times:
   - "B Riemann";
   - twice "B Riemann, Dr. ph.", each followed by an address line beginning "Barfüßerstr." (Barfüßerstraße, a street in Göttingen) plus a short abbreviation that is hard to read.
5. Lower left are two date notes. One in red ink/pencil reads roughly "Jul 27. 55." (possibly 'Jul.'). One in black ink reads "April 2?. 55". These are probably the issue and return dates of the loan, or a librarian's annotation.
6. A large pencil flourish or initial, perhaps 'D' or a librarian's mark, and a long pencil stroke cross the lower middle.
7. The '35' at the right margin is the archival folio number.

Historical significance: the slip records that in 1855 Riemann (then Privatdozent, Dr. phil.) borrowed or requested tomes 10-11 of the Savants étrangers series. That year he was working on Abelian functions, the hypergeometric series and mathematical physics, and he lectured on partial differential equations. Which memoir in those volumes he wanted cannot be determined from this page.

transcription_corrections: Line 2 is in pencil and reads 'de l'Inst. de France'. The four pencil lines continue the title as 'de l'Inst[itut] de France par divers savants, Sc. math. et phys., 1848. 1851'.
The signature reads 'B Riemann', as given; the machine reading is plausible. The address line begins 'Barfüßerstr.', and the following abbreviation is uncertain, not clearly 'Agel'.
The two date notes are not identical. The red one reads approximately 'Jul 27. 55.' and the black one approximately 'April 2[2/7]. 55.'; they should not both be given as 'April 27. 55'.
There is a large pencil flourish or initial (possibly 'D') and a long diagonal pencil stroke in the lower middle, which the machine transcription omits.
The two pencil dashes at the upper right, after 'de France', are omitted.
'Göttingen, den 10. Aug. 1855.' is correctly marked as struck through.
